title: Digital Media Buyer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Overview

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.

Responsibilities

  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Monitor real-time campaign performance and proactively adjust bids, budgets, and targeting to improve efficiency and results.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

title: Controllership Analyst, Junior/Pleno - Campinas
description:
Overview

Somos especialistas em transformação tecnológica , unindo expertise humana à IA para criar soluções tech escaláveis. Com mais de 7 .400 CI&Ters ao redor do mundo, já formamos parcerias com mais de 1.000 clientes durante nossos 30 anos de história. Inteligência Artificial é nossa realidade.

Importante : se você resides na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Você atuará junto ao time global nas entregas da Controladoria (Fechamento Mensal, Forecast, Budget e acompanhamento de KPIs, com foco na elaboração de reports gerenciais).

Será responsável por garantir a integridade e clareza das informações financeiras, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões.

Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e consolidar relatórios financeiros detalhados, assegurando a precisão e relevância dos dados apresentados;
  • Realizar análises de flutuação financeira, Variação Cambial e de Resultado entre períodos, alinhando-se às particularidades do negócio e sazonalidades, para apoiar a tomada de decisões;
  • Acompanhar detalhadamente todas as linhas do P&L, identificando variações e insights relevantes;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de fechamento mensal e da elaboração do Budget anual e Forecast mensal;
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos da área de forma contínua, promovendo a integração com outras equipes para automação e ganho de produtividade;
  • Estruturar e atuar em processos de PDCA;
  • Atender as demandas da área de Relações com Investidores, Controles Internos e auditorias internas e externas;
  • Facilitar a troca de experiências e aplicação de boas práticas dentro do time e com outros times e realizar a difusão das regras de negócio através de comunicação assertiva sobre as diretrizes da CI&T.

Requisitos mandatórios :

  • Experiência de 5 anos com todo o P&L e Análises de flutuação;
  • Experiência em análise, planejamento e controle, considerando o P&L integral;
  • Experiência com processo de Fechamento Mensal, Forecast e Budget;
  • Experiência com reporting e demonstrações de resultado;
  • Experiência em fechamento contábil mensal e elaboração de relatórios financeiros detalhados;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de dados (preferencialmente o Power BI)
  • Experiência em trabalho no âmbito global (entidades no exterior);
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para conversação
  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Habilidade de negociação e mobilização para ações efetivas;
  • Tiver paixão por novos aprendizados e desafios;
  • Já tiver atuado com Lean e Métodos Ágeis;
  • Possuir um mindset voltado para a melhoria contínua e eficiência de processos;
  • Possuir experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA.

Benefícios :

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale alimentação e refeição;
  • Licença parental estendida;
  • Parceria com academias e profissionais de saúde e bem-estar via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • Plataforma de aprendizagem contínua (CI&T University);
  • Plataforma online gratuita dedicada à promoção da saúde física, mental e bem-estar;
  • Curso gestante e parentalidade responsável;

Na CI&T, a inclusão começa no primeiro contato. Se você é pessoa com deficiência, é importante apresentar o seu laudo durante o processo seletivo. Assim, podemos garantir o suporte e as adaptações que você merece. Se ainda não tem o laudo caracterizador, não se preocupe: podemos te apoiar para obtê-lo.

Temos um time dedicado de Saúde e Bem-estar, especialistas em inclusão e grupos de afinidade que estarão com você em todas as etapas. Conte com a gente para fazer essa jornada lado a lado.

title: Analista de Processos/Analista Funcional
description:
Better Now |São Paulo - SP | Remoto

Descrição da vaga

Estamos procurando um Analista Funcional para atuar em projetos de mapeamento de processos e apoio à transformação digital, com foco em soluções voltadas para canais de atendimento. O profissional será responsável por entender as necessidades das áreas de negócio, modelar processos e apoiar a implementação de soluções tecnológicas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Levantar e documentar os processos atuais dos sistemas de atendimento (AS IS), incluindo canais como CRM e possivelmente telefone, chat e e-mail;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e workshops com stakeholders das áreas de negócio;
  • Modelar os processos futuros (TO BE) em conjunto com as áreas demandantes, alinhando com as diretrizes da nova solução Salesforce;
  • Produzir documentos funcionais, fluxogramas e apresentações executivas para apoiar a tomada de decisão e o desenvolvimento da solução;
  • Atuar como ponte entre as áreas de negócio e a equipe técnica, garantindo o entendimento e a rastreabilidade dos requisitos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada como Analista Funcional em projetos de mapeamento de processos e transformação digital;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos (ex: BPMN) e ferramentas como Visio, Bizagi, Lucidchart ou similares;
  • Vivência com sistemas de atendimento multicanal (telefone, chat, e-mail, CRM);
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, organização e relacionamento com áreas diversas.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com projetos envolvendo Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Certificações em análise de negócios (CBAP, PMI-PBA) são um diferencial.
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição (Swile): R$ 660,00/mês;
  • Auxílio Home Office: R$ 100,00/mês;
  • Auxílio Creche (conforme acordo coletivo);
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica Clássico (100% custeado pela empresa, sem coparticipação);
  • Plano Odontológico SulAmérica (100% custeado pela empresa, sem coparticipação);
  • Auxílio Educação Alura (mensalidade paga 100% pela empresa);
  • Parceria com escolas de inglês e faculdades;
  • Total Pass: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Wellhub: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Acesso ao Sesc São Paulo.

Sobre a empresa

Somos a BetterNow, uma consultoria em qualidade de software que valoriza relações próximas, processos simples e um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo. Nosso propósito é criar soluções que realmente façam a diferença, com foco na excelência, na transparência e na entrega de valor para os nossos clientes. Aqui, você vai encontrar uma cultura aberta, que valoriza a troca de ideias, o aprendizado contínuo e a autonomia. Trabalhamos com metodologias ágeis, buscamos inovação e acreditamos que, mais do que processos, são as pessoas que garantem a qualidade em cada entrega. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais e oportunidade de crescer junto, a BetterNow é o seu lugar!

title: Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers daily in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment-related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user IDs, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as a liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate the completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP-based interfaces using IBM and third-party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem-free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software-based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX HA1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface/job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS.
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser-based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks on time to ensure PCI compliance
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially related to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities on time
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)

Other Highly Desired Skills

  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

Gerente de Categoria de Compras

Local: Campinas/SP

Descrição da função

Como parte da equipe de compras da Medley, o gerente conduz a estratégia de categoria, a implementação de sourcing estratégico e a excelência operacional, em conformidade com os procedimentos e melhores práticas corporativas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciamento de Categorias e Implantação de Sourcing Estratégico
  • Conduzir o desenvolvimento do Gerenciamento de Categorias para a categoria responsável (principalmente materiais diretos; experiência em materiais indiretos será apreciada).
  • Desenvolver práticas de inteligência de mercado (dinâmicas e tendências) e avaliar e analisar continuamente o mercado fornecedor.
  • Capturar a inovação da categoria antecipadamente e avaliar o potencial no ambiente Medley com o apoio das partes interessadas relevantes.
  • Implemente efetivamente estratégias de sourcing para todos os gastos de subcategorias.
  • Parceria de negócios
  • Desenvolver parcerias de negócios robustas e conduza o gerenciamento das partes interessadas para atender às necessidades de negócios de forma adequada.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos sólidos de engajamento de negócios.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida do Fornecedor e Gestão do Relacionamento com o Fornecedor
  • Desenvolver uma matriz de recursos do fornecedor para identificar os negócios e os recursos dos fornecedores existentes e novos.
  • Segmente os fornecedores em grupos distintos e defina estratégias de fornecedores relevantes.
  • Gerenciar o processo de Gestão de Relacionamento com Fornecedores com os principais parceiros estratégicos para o âmbito local.
  • Estabeleça planos de mitigação de riscos quando necessário.
  • Atividades operacionais
  • Gerenciar atividades de compras de categoria regional e local, incluindo gerenciamento de demanda e experiência de compra.
  • Gestão de Demanda
  • Elaboração de um plano de demanda alinhado com o negócio e a estratégia da categoria
  • Construir um projeto sólido e um pipeline de economia durante o ciclo orçamentário e mantê-lo ao longo do ano
  • Desafiar construtivamente a demanda e moldá-la para agregar o máximo valor aos negócios.
  • Source-to-Pay (experiência de compra)
  • Projetar e executar um processo de licitação competitivo para a categoria, buscando as melhores soluções de valor agregado dos fornecedores.
  • Avaliar as ofertas competitivas dos fornecedores e desenvolver estratégias de negociação que atendam aos requisitos de negócios.
  • Realizar uma análise de custos aprofundada para desenvolver iniciativas de economia direcionadas por meio de várias frentes de redução de custos.
  • Parceria com as equipes jurídica, de conformidade e finanças para a conclusão bem-sucedida de negociações complexas.
  • Oferecer economia e redução de custos e rastreá-las em um sistema de relatórios para garantir que as economias negociadas sejam transformadas em economias realizadas e reais.
  • Melhorar a gestão de caixa e o índice de capital de giro.
  • Promover a cultura de ética e integridade nos negócios na equipe, assegurando o adequado conhecimento e cumprimento dos princípios de ética e integridade, políticas da empresa e códigos de conduta que regulam o mercado farmacêutico.
  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da empresa em relação à equipe gerenciada, incluindo o Programa de Segurança Viária, com o objetivo de prevenir acidentes, reduzir riscos à saúde e impactos ambientais.
  • Apoiar a estratégia e as iniciativas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão para assegurar tratamento igual aos colaboradores e parceiros.

Sobre você

  • Experiência: Experiência em Gestão de Categorias e Strategic Sourcing.
  • Competências técnicas e pessoais: A posição requer um profissional de sourcing capaz de desenvolver relacionamentos dentro e entre as diferentes linhas de negócios e em toda a organização de compras; forte conhecimento dos processos de RFx (RFI/RFP/RFQ); histórico comprovado de liderança de negociações comerciais e jurídicas; forte compreensão de contratos legais; experiência em ferramentas de eSourcing e eProcurement (SAP/ERP); trabalho em equipe com excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais; experiência em gestão de projetos e contratos locais; conhecimento intermediário de finanças e análise de custos.
  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação preferencialmente em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou Finanças; pós-graduação (preferencialmente nas mesmas áreas).
  • Línguas: Fluente em Inglês.

Por que escolher a Medley?

A Medley, unidade de negócios de genéricos da Sanofi, tem como foco democratizar o acesso à saúde no Brasil, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas principalmente para cardiologia, saúde feminina, doenças do sistema nervoso central e gastroenterologia. Há mais de 29 anos oferecemos medicamentos de qualidade a milhares de brasileiros, com reconhecimento pela eficácia na produção de genéricos, seguindo critérios de qualidade e rigor científico.

Uma das nossas prioridades é melhorar a experiência das pessoas em suas jornadas de saúde, oferecendo conteúdos relevantes, campanhas educativas e serviços de apoio. A Medley é patrocinadora do Comitê Olímpico do Brasil e apoia o esporte e a saúde dos brasileiros.

Persiga o progresso. Descubra o extraordinário. A Sanofi oferece oportunidades iguais a todos, sem discriminação de raça, cor, ascendência, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, idade, cidadania, estado civil, deficiência ou identidade de gênero.

Veja informações sobre Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão e ações da empresa. Esta posição pode exigir cumprimento de políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) e vacinação conforme políticas da empresa.

title: Especialista de Infraestrutura
description:
Overview

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Cultura Organizacional

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server (avançado), Linux (diferencial);
  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS) e Microsoft 365;
  • Redes: TCP/IP, roteamento, switching, WiFi, VPNs, Firewalls;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Additional information

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto (home office), com necessidade de deslocamento para nossa sede em Barretos/SP em média 4 vezes ao ano para alinhamentos e eventos de equipe.

title: Program Director
description:
If digital transformation, next-generation technology, and growth opportunities excite you, then join our Netcracker Technology team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams, earn a competitive salary, and contribute to the largest digital transformations around the world.

What’s in it for you? At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations, and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren’t micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.

Overview

The Program Director has the two-fold role of securing and delivering professional services for the Netcracker customer base. The Program Director will be involved in E2E activities to ensure that service commitments are attainable and profitable.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow Netcracker’s on-site transformation programs, including the following:
  • Budget and business planning for projects and programs including forecasting, monitoring, and resource planning, while ensuring business profitability
  • Manage customer expectations and satisfaction
  • Generate additional profitable revenue by expanding the scope of services provided by Netcracker
  • Partner with Sales Team to support new solution revenue opportunities within accounts through the creation of calculations and proposals, execution of contract negotiations, and pre-sales consulting.
  • Represent Solution Delivery in presales activities, ensuring that Netcracker deployment methodologies are accurately represented to potential customers
  • Lead recurring governance meetings with client steering committee to ensure alignment on program milestones and future strategy.
  • Hold Account Teams accountable for project deliverables
  • Manage all resources to ensure that all program commitments are completed on time, within budget, and with high quality
  • Lead service delivery and customer support activities related to the Netcracker product suite
  • Establish and grow relationships with clients at all levels in the organization
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives and SMEs, participating in strategic and roadmap discussions on business transformation.
  • Lead cross-functional, multi-cultural, geographically dispersed teams
  • Establish and manage MBOs/KPIs for the team
  • Partner with leadership to create and maintain departmental staffing plans, organizational charts, budgets, and other appropriate departmental documentation
  • Interact with Engineering and Product Management departments in an effective manner, providing input for ongoing product enhancements

Experience and Requirements

  • Proven ability to lead multi-million, business transformational programs in
    volving complex technical solutions, for OSS/BSS Telecoms projects.
  • Required experience with writing and reviewing contracts , SOWs, and other commercial agreements
  • Proven ability to handle program governance, ensuring alignment on program milestones and future strategy
  • Ability to build and execute resource plans (on/offshore)
  • 10 years management experience, at least 3 years at senior levels
  • Experience running multi-million programs
  • Extensive experience with project management methodologies
  • Ability to build relationships at multiple levels within the client organization
  • Experience working in a matrixed corporate environment
  • Ability to travel
  • Must be able to work from the office in a Hybrid mode
  • A fluent English speaker - is a must

Education

  • University Degree in Computer Science or related field

Who is Netcracker Technology? We are a forward-looking software company, offering mission-critical solutions to service providers around the globe. Our comprehensive portfolio of software solutions and professional services enables large-scale digital transformations, unlocking the opportunities of the cloud, analytics, virtualization, and 5G mobile networks. With an unbroken service delivery track record of more than 25 years, our unique combination of technology, people and expertise helps companies transform their networks and enable better experiences for their customers.

We help you focus on the most important step you\'ll take. Your next one.

Take your strategy, your operations, and your business forward today.

title: Página da Vaga | Agente Prevenção de Perdas
description:
Procuramos profissionais que sejam #SoluçãoParaoCliente , #ConfiemColaboremCompartilhem e que tenham #AlegriaEnergiaeAcolhimento !

Atuamos no varejo de moda há 50 anos e estamos presentes nos estados de São Paulo, Rio grande do Sul, Goiás, DF e Minas Gerais com 100 lojas .

Temos um ambiente alegre e acolhedor e o melhor de tudo, com possibilidade de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional!

Se você busca desafios em sua área de atuação, não abre mão de ética e respeito , tem senso de dono e acredita que juntos somos mais fortes , vem para Caedu .

Na Caedu nós trabalhamos com um propósito claro: Compartilhar o que temos de melhor para vestir histórias mais felizes. Para isso, respeitamos a diversidade, trabalhamos com senso de dono e queremos proporcionar o melhor para os nossos colaboradores e cliente SEMPRE!

Quais serão suas atividades?

  • Realizar rondas diárias em todas as dependências da loja, principalmente nas áreas de riscos, como provadores, área de vendas, estoques e caixa.
  • Fiscalizar o setor de estoque quando do recebimento e envio de mercadorias e produtos, incluindo a chegada dos caminhões, recebimento, contagem e conferência de peças e equipamentos pelos operadores, controle dos coletores e notas fiscais, de modo a contribuir para a redução de perdas e riscos para a empresa.
  • Responder pelos registros nos livros de prevenção e perdas, informando data, horário e tipo de ocorrência, com relação a colaboradores e clientes, apresentando a supervisão e gerência para controles diversos e GPP.
  • Atuar de forma discreta na prevenção de roubos e furtos nas dependências internas, entradas e saídas da loja, observando atitudes suspeitas e delitos, utilizando rádio para comunicar, obter orientações e aplicar ações de acordo com as regras e procedimentos, de modo a minimizar os riscos para a empresa, informando à gerência.
  • Acompanhar o gerente e supervisores na abertura e fechamento da loja, fazendo rondas em todo o perímetro da mesma, bem como na chegada e saída do carro forte, contribuindo para a segurança do patrimônio e numerários.
  • Contribuir para a redução dos custos com consumo de água e energia, através de vistorias de hora em hora nos setores tomando ações para eliminar consumos desnecessários.
  • Acompanhar as imagens dos monitores de segurança (CFTV) nas dependências internas da empresa, verificando as ações, monitorando as ocorrências e efetuando as gravações e backups diários com o apoio da equipe de Prevenção de Perdas de modo a registrar todos os movimentos para controles, possíveis investigações e decisões corretivas pela empresa.
  • Realizar o controle e entrega de chaves dos armários e vistorias dos pertences dos colaboradores, anotando as ocorrências em formulários específicos, informando à supervisão os problemas detectados.
  • Realizar o controle de entrada e saída dos produtos nos provadores, observando e efetuando a entrega, conferência e recebimento de fichas junto aos clientes, registrando as intercorrências em formulários específicos, conforme orientações dos manuais.
  • Conferir através do coletor com o apoio dos líderes da loja, os produtos recebidos em loja com procedência de troca, bem como executar a conferência e controle dos produtos danificados, verificando se os itens estão devidamente etiquetados e com os alarmes corretamente posicionados, solicitando ao superior ou responsável ações corretivas, com os devidos registros nos livros.
  • Realizar o atendimento a clientes na área de vendas quando necessário, auxiliando e orientando sobre a localização dos produtos, promoções e oferecendo sacolas e cartões, contribuindo assim para a satisfação dos clientes e resultados da loja.
  • Atender o cliente com simpatia, agilidade e clareza nas informações, visando a satisfação dos mesmos e a oportunidade de comercialização dos produtos.
  • Cumprir a jornada de trabalho diária, conforme escala mensal e semanal sem cometer irregularidades nas marcações e seguindo a legislação e orientações do líder e supervisor.
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência na posição de fiscal/segurança, tendo atuado em áreas de prevenção, perdas e riscos, bem como atendimento ao cliente em vendas em geral.

description:
Líder de Análise de Dados - Trabalho Remoto | REF#

Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev® é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício. Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global. Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.

Líder de Análise de Dados na BairesDev

Estamos à procura de um Líder de Análise de Dados para se juntar à nossa equipe. Esse profissional será responsável por manter a integridade do nosso processo de dados, incluindo originação, aquisição, fluxo e processamento.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Realizar análise de dados, navegar e revisar grandes conjuntos de dados, aprender e pesquisar funções de gerenciamento de dados de aplicativos e gerar relatórios.
  • Realizar investigações de monitoramento e alertas/escalonamento gerados pelo sistema relacionados a possíveis falhas no ambiente de serviço.
  • Interagir com engenheiros técnicos internos e fornecedores externos de terceiros para solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos.
  • Aplicar e desenvolver conhecimentos de tecnologia publicitária, especialmente operações de DSP, e processo de publicidade digital.
  • Ajudar a definir e testar automação de processos manuais.
  • Realizar acompanhamento diário, semanal e mensal de relatórios e fluxos de trabalho para garantir que as operações não sejam interrompidas.
  • Trabalhar entre equipes, como desenvolvimento, gerenciamento de produtos e grupos de finanças para pesquisar e resolver erros de cálculo de dados relatados pelo usuário.
  • Dar suporte às necessidades de faturamento financeiro, entendendo faturamento e relatórios em vários mercados/países, fornecendo suporte avançado a usuários internos e externos.
  • Criar, manter e documentar soluções de software/aplicativo e dados.

Esperamos Que Você Tenha

  • Licenciatura em Ciência da Computação ou Engenharia, Matemática ou Tecnologia.
  • 3+ anos de experiência de trabalho em uma função de gerenciamento de dados, suportando soluções de dados complexas.
  • Experiência de trabalho com análise de dados no setor de mídia de publicidade digital.
  • Experiência em liderar, orientar e auxiliar outros membros da equipe - a pessoa deve trabalhar extremamente bem em equipe e conseguir trabalhar em um ambiente multicultural e global com membros da equipe localizados remotamente.
  • Experiência de trabalho com SQL e habilidades avançadas de Microsoft Excel.
  • Capacidade de distinguir entre questões críticas e não críticas (forte capacidade de triagem e resolução de problemas).
  • Experiência de trabalho com as necessidades de Finanças e Faturamento.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Nível avançado de inglês.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil

  • Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.
  • Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.
  • Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.
  • Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário.
  • Licença parental remunerada, férias, e feriados nacionais.
  • Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.
  • Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.
  • Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades, e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.

Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo a Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais cresce no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

  • Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
  • Pensamos e agimos como donos
  • Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
  • Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade
  • Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A \"Whatever it takes\" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Overview

Vaga de SDR Estratégico para a unidade de Campinas/SP da V4 Company. Somos a Maior Assessoria de Marketing Digital do Brasil em número de clientes, com foco em Resultado Final: VENDAS. Operamos com um Método Científico (Tráfego, Engajamento, Conversão e Retenção) para transformar negócios. Este é um cargo presencial, de tempo integral, atuando como motor de crescimento na área de vendas internas, do primeiro contato ao agendamento de reuniões.

Responsabilidades

  • Identificar e Prospectar: pesquisar e encontrar novos clientes em potencial com alto fit (Outbound) e qualificar os leads que chegam do Marketing (Inbound).
  • Gerar Leads Qualificados: aplicar um diagnóstico consultivo utilizando frameworks como o SPIN Selling para entender as dores e a situação do lead, e o BANT (Budget, Authority, Need, Time) para mapear o potencial de compra.
  • Agendamento Estratégico: agendar reuniões de altíssima qualidade para os Closers, munindo-os de informações essenciais para o fechamento.
  • Gestão de Funil: manter o CRM e o processo de cadência de contatos organizados para garantir a previsibilidade das vendas.

Perfil e Qualificações

  • Experiência em Vendas Internas (Inside Sales): histórico comprovado em pré-vendas, geração e qualificação de leads B2B.
  • Comunicação de Alto Nível: habilidades verbais e escritas persuasivas e claras, essenciais para interagir com decisores.
  • Foco em Desenvolvimento de Negócios: movido por metas, capaz de identificar e nutrir oportunidades de crescimento.

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. title: Líder de Unidade | Campinas - Shopping Campinas
description:
Job description

Sua missão como Líder de Unidade

Possuir habilidades em vendas e atendimento ao cliente.

Liderar as atividades comerciais em nível corporativo, desenvolvendo estratégias de vendas, assegurando o cumprimento de metas e demonstrando comprometimento com o desempenho da equipe e os resultados.

Prospectar e captar clientes e parcerias , tanto de forma presencial quanto online, identificando oportunidades de mercado e negócios.

Ser responsável por liderar a clínica em suas operações diárias , garantindo a excelência no atendimento.

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades do cargo

  • Gerir as metas, tanto mensais quanto por dezenas, bem como realizar os planos de ação para o alcance das mesmas;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores;
  • Atender clientes para esclarecer dúvidas e tratar demais assuntos relacionados ao serviço e ao tratamento prestados pela empresa;
  • Prezar pelo padrão da unidade nos critérios de limpeza, organização e cumprimento de todos os protocolos adequados à fiscalização;
  • Gerir os insumos necessários para a unidade sob sua liderança;
  • Ser a porta-voz e defensora das diretrizes da empresa perante clientes internos e externos;
  • Realizar ações proativas na captação de parcerias e indicações de Leads, desenvolvendo e implementando estratégias para atingir as metas da unidade;
  • Elaborar a escala de trabalho e realizar a gestão do ponto da equipe sob sua liderança;
  • Garantir a qualidade e a eficiência no atendimento ao cliente;
  • Monitorar e analisar o desempenho da unidade, implementando melhorias quando necessário;
  • Realizar o fechamento do caixa, sendo necessário profissional com disponibilidade de horário;
  • Gerir, motivar e desenvolver a equipe, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo;
  • Solucionar problemas, mantendo a excelência no atendimento e zelando pela reputação da empresa;
  • Manter a unidade em conformidade com as normas internas e regulamentos exigidos pela legislação;
  • Executar demais atividades correlatas.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e habilidades

  • Ensino médio completo – Graduação (em andamento ou concluída) será um diferencial;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de vendas e liderança de equipes;
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais (multitarefa e planejamento) e de comunicação;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões de forma eficaz;
  • Orientação para resultados, com foco na qualidade do atendimento;
  • Proatividade e habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão.

Additional information

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica (70% custeada pela empresa, com coparticipação);
  • Vale-refeição/ alimentação no valor de R$ 500,00;
  • Seguro de vida (100% custeado pela empresa);
  • Convênio com a TotalPass;
  • Vale-transporte.

title: Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD
description:
Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD

Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD role at Trilogy.

This range is provided by Trilogy. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$200.00/hr - $200.00/hr

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years in product leadership positions where you personally developed product vision and owned fundamental problem-solution hypotheses
  • Proven track record launching at least one successful product from conception to market—specifically a complete product (not just features) that reached external users and generated minimum $1M in revenue
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI tools into your professional workflow (analysis, research, strategy development, information synthesis)

About LearnWith.AI

LearnWith.AI is an edtech startup that leverages AI and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and AI-powered coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult for more details on this topic.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
Overview

Omada Health is on a mission to inspire and engage people in lifelong health, one step at a time.

Job overview: As the Director, Product Design, you will be a pivotal leader within the product organization, responsible for driving our long-term design strategy and cultivating a world-class team dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will manage the product design team partnering with brand, product, engineering and clinical to ensure a consistent, intuitive, and high-quality experience for both consumers and care team members. Your role will involve collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, engineering, and marketing to align design efforts with broader business objectives. You will spearhead the development of scalable, repeatable design systems and guidelines, while your leadership will emphasize user-centered design, innovation, and compliance. With a focus on personalization for key member segments at various stages of their health journeys, you will ensure that our products drive higher engagement, retention, and outcomes. Your strategic leadership, impeccable design eye, and user-centric approach will be instrumental in guiding the UI/UX vision and its execution across all touchpoints, ultimately achieving measurable impacts on member delight and business success.

Applicants should submit a portfolio showcasing a proven track record in creating consumer-focused UX that solves complex design problems providing impact to customers and the business, ideally within a healthcare category.

Your Impact

  • Team Development and Mentorship: Provide coaching, mentorship, and career development for the product design team to maximize their impact and professional growth.
  • Design Excellence and Learning Culture: Champion best-in-class design practices and foster a culture of continuous learning to elevate design excellence.
  • User Experience and Interface Design: Oversee the development of user-centered design processes, including research and testing, and ensure consistent, appealing UI designs across platforms.
  • Design System: Develop and maintain a scalable design system.
  • Innovation: Encourage innovation through AI and emerging technologies to enhance the design process.
  • Strategic Hiring and Organizational Scaling: Implement strategic hiring practices, effective onboarding processes, and develop a robust organizational design to scale the design team.
  • Vision and Strategy Articulation: Craft and communicate a design strategy that aligns with product and business objectives, while also advocating for the role of design at the executive level
  • Strategic Decision-Making and Leadership: Apply strategic leadership and problem-solving skills to navigate complex challenges and align design efforts with long-term company goals.
  • Clear Expectations and Accountability: Set clear goals, roles, and responsibilities, and establish rhythms of accountability to maintain performance standards and a healthy team culture.
  • Collaboration and Influence: Lead cross-functional collaboration, leveraging influence and communication skills to drive change and align with company values across different departments.
  • Customer Insights: Partner with the user research and clinical teams to gather insights that inform design decisions (research is a partner, not a director report).
  • Compliance: Ensure compliance with accessibility standards and relevant regulations.

About you

  • A Bachelor’s degree in user experience, design, or other related field
  • You have 10+ years of experience in product design, turning complex problems into engaging design solutions
  • You have at least 5 years of experience managing and scaling teams larger than 5 ICs including principal and staff level designers, with a track record of scaling and developing high-performing teams.
  • You have a deep understanding of user-centered design processes and consumer-focused digital experiences
  • You have direct experience driving strategic business outcomes through design of apps, ideally within the health category
  • You possess exceptional strategic thinking and execution skills, capable of translating high-level vision into tactical plans while maintaining a focus on detail.
  • You are a seasoned leader with a strong ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • You are a proactive problem-solver with the ability to navigate complex cross functional challenges and drive clarity in ambiguous situations
  • Appreciation of standards; proven methods and tools to enforce brand identity and consistency across all projects
  • An ability to prioritize work in a fast paced environment and meet changing deadlines and priorities on multiple simultaneous projects
  • Demonstrated expertise in integrating AI, ML, or automation both in design workflows and shipped product experiences.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health

Omada Health is a between-visit healthcare provider that addresses lifestyle and behavior change elements for individuals managing chronic conditions. Omada’s multi-condition platform treats diabetes, hypertension, prediabetes, musculoskeletal, and GLP-1 management. With insights from connected devices and AI-supported tools, Omada care teams deliver care that is rooted in evidence and unique to every member, unlocking results at scale. With more than a decade of experience and data, and 29 peer-reviewed publications showcasing clinical and economic proof points, Omada’s approach is designed to improve health outcomes and contain costs. Our customers include health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, health systems, and employers ranging from small businesses to Fortune 500s. At Omada, we aim to inspire and empower people to make lasting health changes on their own terms. For more information, visit: omadahealth.com

We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Atuar como líder na implementação e manutenção de uma arquitetura corporativa integrada, alinhando-a com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de negócios e técnicas, promovendo sinergia e garantindo que os requisitos técnicos sejam incorporados nas soluções.

  • Experiência em Arquitetura Corporativa.

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com desenvolvedores em ambiente terceirizado.
  • Experiência em navegação por políticas organizacionais e habilidade de influenciar stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de articular novas ideias para públicos técnicos e não técnicos, compreender perspectivas de longo e curto prazo, traduzir requisitos de negócio em requisitos de arquitetura, e estimar impactos financeiros de alternativas de solução.
  • Trazer curiosidade intelectual, integridade, comprometimento com resultados de longo prazo e habilidade de trabalhar bem em equipe.

Habilidades que vão fazer você se Destacar

Esta é uma vaga abrangente a todas as pessoas interessadas. Trabalhamos diariamente para construir um ambiente diverso e plural, que valoriza e respeita as diferenças e defendemos a liberdade de ser quem se é, livre de estereótipos e preconceitos.

title: Supervisor Case Manager Long-term Care - Delaware
description:
Overview

Company : Highmark Inc.

Job Description : JOB SUMMARY

This job manages a team of Case Managers charged with promoting quality member outcomes to optimize member benefits and to promote effective use of resources for members enrolled in DSHP Plus LTSS. Provides direct oversight to Case Managers, meets all of the requirements of a Case Manager and be able to assist in the day to day responsibilities of a Case Manager as needed. This is a full time community based position requiring frequent travel within the assigned territory in Delaware.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of community based Case Managers.
  • Promote quality member outcomes to optimize member benefits and to promote effective use of resources.
  • Act as a role model to staff and assisting in the day to day activities as needed.
  • Ensure care is medically appropriate, high quality, and cost effective.
  • Conduct frequent ride-alongs and shadowing of Case Managers for hands on support, quality assurance, and to identify training opportunities.
  • Apply clinical knowledge to work with facilities and providers for care-coordination.
  • Participate in rounds with the Medical Director.
  • Review documentation and processes for consistent practice, and to identify opportunities for growth.
  • Initiate and implement process improvements.
  • Assist Case Managers in finding solutions to challenging situations and overcoming obstacles to meeting member’s needs.
  • Identify and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Suggest new approaches to complex problems.
  • Ensure all staff achieve the minimal qualification of their position through ongoing staff development, counsel, individual and group education.
  • Ensure direct reports meet process and documentation in order to be compliant with regulatory agencies, including but not limited to: NCQA, URAC, CMS, DOH, and DOL.
  • Develop and implement modifications to ensure appropriate distribution of workload in compliance with Delaware Case Manager caseload requirements.
  • Recruit, select, orient, evaluate, counsel, and develop performance improvement plans; promote and terminate per corporate policy; and encourage career development and support of staff.
  • Adhere to all company, State and Federal requirements related to privacy practices, HIPAA, and quality performance standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned/requested.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Social Work or in health, human, or education services and 3 years of experience in long-term care, home health, hospice, public health, or assisted living

Or

  • Master’s degree in Social Work or in health, human, or education services and 1 year of experience in long-term care, home health, hospice, public health, or assisted living

Or

  • Registered Nurse or Licensed Practical Nurse and 2 years of experience in long-term care, home health, hospice, public health, or assisted living

Substitutions

  • Registered Nurse or Licensed Practical Nurse and 2 years of experience in long-term care, home health, hospice, public health, or assisted living in lieu of Bachelor's degree

Preferred

  • Two years of supervisory or managerial experience.
  • Certified Case Manager (CCM)
  • Licensed Bachelors Social Worker (LBSW)
  • Licensed Masters Social Worker (LMSW)
  • Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
  • Experience working with HIV/AIDS population
  • Experience working with behavioral health population
  • Experience working with developmental disabilities population
  • Two years in home clinical or case management experience
  • Medicare and Medicaid experience
  • Managed care experience

Skills

  • Leadership skills and be able to relate to all levels of management and staff as well as individuals external to the corporation
  • Leadership, collaboration, and motivational skills
  • Ability to multi task and perform in a fast paced, and often intense environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to analyze data, measure outcomes and develop action plans
  • Team player that possesses strong analytical and organizational skill
  • The ability to prioritize work demands and meet deadlines
  • Proficiency in PC-based word processing and database documentation (Word, Excel, Internet, Outlook)
  • Reliable transportation daily to be able to travel within assigned territory
  • Ability to meet regulatory deadlines.
  • Has a dedicated home work space used only for business purposes and is able to comply with all telecommuter policies
  • Experience in geriatric special needs, behavioral health, home health
  • Understanding of the importance of cultural competency in addressing targeted populations.
  • Experience with electronic documentation system(s)
  • Experience with cost neutrality and budgeting

Scope of Responsibility

Does this role supervise/manage other employees?

Yes

Work Environment

Is Travel Required?

Yes

title: Senior Solution Architect - Customer Success (Brazil)
description:
Overview

Senior Solution Architect - Customer Success (Brazil) at Articul8 AI. You will shape GenAI-based solutions, working with customers' technical and business leaders to understand gaps and objectives, and craft scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures.

About us

At Articul8 AI, we relentlessly pursue excellence and create exceptional AI products that exceed customer expectations. We are a team of dedicated individuals who take pride in our work and strive for greatness in every aspect of our business. We believe in using our advantages to make a positive impact on the world and inspiring others to do the same.

Job Description

Articul8 AI is seeking an exceptional Solution Architect to join us in shaping the future of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI). You will work within the Product Technology team with customers’ technical and business leaders to understand their technical gaps, needs, and business objectives. You will craft GenAI-based solutions that promote innovation and accelerate bringing new products to market. This role offers opportunities to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to drive enterprise-grade GenAI innovations.

Responsibilities

  • Solution Design: Develop detailed, scalable architectural designs addressing client needs using Articul8 products and third-party tools.
  • Piloting and Prototyping: Run pilot programs with customers to demonstrate feasibility and advantages; introduce new features or build prototypes as needed.
  • Client Interaction: Engage with clients through workshops, meetings, and presentations to communicate solutions and best practices.
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize for performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness; select instance types, auto-scaling configurations, and storage options.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure solutions meet security best practices and regulatory requirements; implement IAM, data encryption, and related measures.
  • Documentation and Training: Create comprehensive architecture documentation and provide training to clients or internal teams.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate with Applied Research, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Customer Success to maintain product technology leadership.
  • Leadership: Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of rapid innovation.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience: 2+ years in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructure; 4+ years in technology domains such as software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics.
  • Education: BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technology stack: Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); Languages (Python, Node.js, Go, Ruby); APIs/Integration (OpenAPI, FastAPI, Swagger, Flask, REST); Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis); ML Frameworks (PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Keras); Development/Deployment (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes); Monitoring/Logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK); Version Control (Git, GitHub, GitLab); Architecture Design/Modeling (Microsoft Visio, Drawio); Collaboration/Project Management (JIRA, Confluence, Trello).
  • Education: Master’s or PhD in Computer Science or related fields preferred.
  • Experience developing tools, libraries, and infrastructure for data preprocessing, model training/finetuning, and deployment of LLMs in research and production environments.

Professional Attributes

  • Problem Solving: Breaks down complex problems into manageable components and devises creative solutions with iterative refinement.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Works effectively in cross-functional teams, communicates clearly, and respects diverse perspectives.
  • Project Management and Prioritization: Balances multiple projects, sets milestones, and monitors progress; allocates time efficiently between short- and long-term goals.
  • Critical Thinking: Evaluates assumptions, questions methodologies, and remains skeptical when interpreting results.
  • Curiosity and Continuous Learning: Maintains a proactive approach to learning and staying updated on related fields.
  • Emotional Intelligence and Intellectual Humility: Demonstrates empathy, resilience, adaptability, self-awareness, and collaboration.

Perks and Benefits

Competitive salary and benefits package, along with:

  • Professional development opportunities, including training and mentorship programs
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote options
  • Access to the latest technologies and tools
  • Regular social events and team-building activities
  • A supportive and inclusive work environment

Note: This position is available via CLT contract only.
